_comment: Factory ABI baseline for dash (REDMI Turbo 5 Max / MT6991).
Source: stock boot.img (SHA256 below) pulled from the device; the BTF blob
was located inside the decompressed arm64 Image (single 0xeb9f BTF header)
and parsed directly, so these numbers are the factory kernel's own ABI,
'hard' entries break prebuilt vendor .ko modules when they drift: the MTK
modules (mtk_task / node_cache / scheduler family) address the GKI vendor
data area by the offset compiled into the stock kernel.
'soft' entries are reviewed deviations: bdi_writeback / backing_dev_info
'hard' entries break prebuilt vendor .ko modules when they drift: the MTK
extra cgroup controller. No stock vendor module references those fields, so
drift is reported but not fatal.

cgroup, bdi_writeback and backing_dev_info moved to 'hard' on 2026-11-24: the boot failures were traced to ABI drift (cgroup_subsys_id numbering with CGROUP_DEVICE/CGROUP_HUGETLB, task_struct with CONFIG_RSEQ), so stock parity is now enforced. kmem_cache is 'soft' because the owner-requested hardening-off knobs (SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED, SLUB_DEBUG) shrink it; vendor modules only hold kmem_cache pointers.
